rows.title: Sunny Your Mind
notes: “and it's called sunny your mind can you describe to the listeners a little bit about that”
Title track of Gabzak's 3-track 'Sunny Your Mind' EP (June 2023, Wile Out label); Gabzak is a Chile-born, Sydney-based multi-instrumentalist/DJ.
“up next we've got Gabu joining us keep it locked”

Gabu is a real Sydney baile-funk DJ tied to the Trackwork label/collective (played their Vivid LIVE 5th-birthday 'Rio street favela party'); no specific track title could be confirmed for this appearance.

rows.title: Candela
notes: 2025 collab single 'Candela' by Busy Twist & Ghetto Kumbé, a tribute to Colombia's Wayuu/Guajira culture, released via London Records.
